raw_title: Sustainable Shirt White Hemp Jules Man | Thinking Mu
raw_meta_title: Sustainable Shirt White Hemp Jules Man | Thinking Mu
raw_meta_description: Discover the Shirt White Hemp Jules by Thinking MU, made with hemp and certified by GOTS, OCS y GRS. Man sustainable fashion with Mediterranean inspiration.
raw_full_description:
Jules white hemp shirt
→ V-neckline with shirt collar
→ Short sleeves
→ Regular fit
→ Front closure with buttons
→ Fabric: hemp mixed with tencel, weight 135 gsm (Lightweight fabric)
→ Length of garment: Regular
Ref: MSH00210
Measurements in size M: 72 cm total length, 49 cm back width and 24 cm sleeve length.
Hemp is an exceptional plant that provides one of the lightest and most breathable sustainable fibers. Main features:
LESS WATER: It needs 95% less water than cotton and produces 2.5 times more fiber.
LESS C02: Its cultivation in the field helps the CO2 absorption process.
LESS PESTICIDES: It does not require the use of chemical pesticides or fertilizers for its cultivation.
LESS TIME: It is a renewable fiber that grows quickly and vigorously in a wide variety of climates.
LESS WASTE: The plant produces 250% more fiber than cotton and 600% more than flax using the same area of land.
LESS CROP: The area required for cultivation is almost half that of cotton.
LESS SOIL EROSION: Prevents soil erosion caused by logging.
The model is 176cm tall and wears a size M.
